mapper.select: select k.id as knowledgePointId, k.name as knowledgePointName, count(*) as total, sum(case when r.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as correct from practice_record r join question q on q.id = r.question_id left join knowledge_point k on k.id = q.knowledge_point_id where r.user_id = #{userId} group by k.id, k.name order by total desc

select date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as answered, sum(case when r.is_correct = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as correct from practice_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.create_time >= #{begin} group by date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date asc
select ifnull(sum(time_spent), 0) from practice_record where user_id = #{userId}
